units.source_text: 决定白子命运的一手，可能反映了名人心理上或生理上的破绽。

en.t: The move that decided White's fate may have reflected some flaw in the Master's mind or body.

units.source_text: 白130既像很厉害的一手，又像很有余味的一着。

en.t: White 130 seemed both a very powerful move and one with a lingering aftertaste.

units.source_text: 我是外行人，当时认为名人一直在防守，这是他企图出击的一手，同时也是他忍无可忍，暴躁起来才下的一着。

en.t: As an amateur, I thought at the time that the Master had been defending all along; this was a move with which he tried to strike out, and also one he played in irritation when he could bear no more.

units.source_text: 据说，如果在之前，白断黑一手的话就没事。

en.t: It is said that if White had cut Black with one move before this, there would have been no problem.

units.source_text: 这白130败着，不至于是名人今早对大竹七段封盘的愤怒的余波吧。

en.t: Surely this losing move, White 130, was not the aftereffect of the Master's anger that morning over Otake 7-dan sealing the move.
There is no way to know what the truth was.

units.source_text: 就算名人本人，也无法了解命运的波澜或过路妖怪的魔力。

en.t: Even the Master himself could not understand the waves of fate or the magic of a passing specter.
